items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: we had fun, Jean and I

ctx.x: That's what happened. Otis went on back to St. Louis. So we got on this train, and we had fun, Jean and I -- the band had a whole private car. And I had one drawing room, and Jeannie had the other drawing room. And we had a ballroom going down there. We'd play all night, man, we'd blow. Then we'd go back to the dining room and eat and all that. It was a lot of fun.

We got to San Francisco, they were very nice to us. They took us sightseeing, took us to see the bridge, took us up on Nob Hill. And a few historical spots. Then they took us out to Hamilton Field and told us not to leave because we were on alert, see. In about a day and a half, we got ready to fly to Honolulu. The sun was shining bright, beautiful day. We had a bucket job.
